questions.question: In which of the following years did the revolt in the countryside of the Bombay Deccan occur?
questions.questionHtml: In which of the following years did the revolt in the countryside of the Bombay Deccan occur?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 1875.

Key Points

  • In 1875, the revolt in the countryside of the Bombay Deccan occurred.
  • In the Bombay Deccan region, the British had introduced the Ryotwari settlement as the system of land revenue.
  • Under this system, the revenue of land was fixed on a yearly basis.
  • ​The revolt of the Bombay Deccan region
    • The uprising began at Supa village in the district of Poona.
    • In 1875, farmers attacked a marketplace where many moneylenders lived.
    • They burnt account books and looted grain shops. They also torched the houses of people who were both traders and moneylenders.
    • The farmers’ main motive was to destroy the account books of the moneylenders and they resorted to violence only when these books were not handed over to them.
    • The movement also got support from the Poona Sarvajanik Sabha co-founded by M G Ranade.
    • Accordingly, the Deccan Riots Commission was set up which presented a report to the British Parliament in 1878.
    • In 1879, the Agriculturists Relief Act was passed which ensured that the farmers could not be arrested and imprisoned if they were unable to pay their debts.

questions.question: As of 26th January 2021, who is the Lok Sabha Speaker?
questions.questionHtml: As of 26th January 2021, who is the Lok Sabha Speaker?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Om Birla.

  • As of 26th January 2021, Om Birla is the speaker of Lok Sabha since 19 June 2019.
  • OM Birla was unanimously elected Speaker of the 17th Lok Sabha.
  • The Opposition did not field any candidate for the Speaker's post and the motion moved by PM Modi to choose the Kota-Bundi MP as Speaker was adopted by a voice vote.

Important Points

  • As per Article 93 of the Indian Constitution, the Lok Sabha has a Speaker and a Deputy Speaker.
  • The Speaker of the Lok Sabha is the presiding officer of the Lok Sabha.
  • The Speaker can be removed from office only on a resolution of the Lok Sabha passed by the absolute majority. It is also mandatory to give a minimum of 14 days' notice of the intention to move the resolution.
  • The vote of the Speaker is called “Casting Vote” as it is cast in case of a tie in the number of votes.
  • The first speaker of Lok Sabha was Ganesh Vasudev Mavalankar.
  • The first female speaker of Lok Sabha is Meira Kumar.

questions.question: ‘Jadopatiya’ is a form of _______ popular in the state of Jharkhand.
questions.questionHtml: ‘Jadopatiya’ is a form of _______ popular in the state of Jharkhand.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is painting.

Key Points

  • ‘Jadopatiya’ is a form of painting, popular in the state of Jharkhand. 
  • The Jadupatua paintings of the Santhal tribes are vertical scroll paintings that were performed on cloth in earlier days but later these paintings were done on papers.
  • The scrolls were made up of sheets of paper that were either glued together or sewn together and a piece of old cloth or calico was sewn to the end of the scroll to protect the paper from damage.
  • The stories in paintings are depicted in a series of simple clear-cut images in panels divided by horizontal bands.
  • Seven themes of the scroll paintings made by jadupatuas in the Santal Parganas are :
    • Life in Death’s kingdom
    • The story of the creation of the Santals as preserved in Santal tradition
    • The Santal festival of Bahajatras
    • Mass meetings of the Santals for dance
    • The personification of Santal clans
    • A tiger or leopard often with a human rider
    • Finally, the adventures of Krishna with the milkmaid.
  • Other folk paintings of Jharkhand-Paitkar, Jadopatia Paintings, Sohrai Art, Kohver Art, Ganju Art, Kurmi Art, Mundas Art, Turi art, Ghatwal art.

questions.question: What do you call the effect of splitting of a spectral line into several components in the presence of a static magnetic field?
questions.questionHtml: What do you call the effect of splitting of a spectral line into several components in the presence of a static magnetic field?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Zeeman effect.

Key Points

  • Zeeman Effect
    • It is the name of the phenomena in physics and astronomy which involves the splitting of a spectral line into two or more components of slightly different frequencies when the light source is placed in a magnetic field.
    • It is named after the Dutch physicist Pieter Zeeman.
    • The effect is caused due to the distortion of the electron orbitals because of the magnetic field.
    • This effect is very useful in investigating the charge/mass ratio and magnetic moment of an electron.

Additional Information

  • Askaryan effect
    • It is the phenomenon whereby a particle travelling faster than the phase velocity of light in a dense dielectric medium (such as salt, ice) produces a shower of secondary charged particles.
    • The Askaryan effect describes coherent electromagnetic radiation from high-energy cascades in dense media with a collective charge.
  • Bezold effect
    • It is an optical illusion.
    • It is named after a German professor of meteorology, Wilhelm von Bezold.
    • He discovered that a colour may appear different depending on its relation to adjacent colours.
    • It happens when small areas of colour are interspersed.

  • Domino effect
    • It is a cumulative effect produced when one event initiates a succession of similar events.
    • It occurs when a significant change in the abundance (or presence) of one species results in a further change to the species composition or relative abundance of other species in a community.

questions.question: The average height of some students in a group is 156 cm. If 5 students of average height 160 cm join the group, then the average height of all the students in the group increases by 0.8 cm. What is the number of students in the group, initially?
questions.questionHtml: The average height of some students in a group is 156 cm. If 5 students of average height 160 cm join the group, then the average height of all the students in the group increases by 0.8 cm. What is the number of students in the group, initially?
questions.solution:
Given:

Average height of some students = 156cm

Formula:

Average = (Sum of terms)/(Number of terms)

Calculation:

Let number of students in a group be N.

Total height of N students = N × 156 = 156N cm

Total height of 5 students = 5 × 160 = 800 cm

Total height of (N + 5) students = 800 + 156N

New average = 156 + 0.8 = 156.8 cm

New number of students = N + 5

Total height of (N + 5) students = (N + 5) × 156.8 = (156.8N + 784) cm

Then,

⇒ 156.8N + 784 = 800 + 156N

⇒ N = 20

∴ Number of students = N = 20

questions.question: A trader bought two articles for Rs.490. He sold one at a loss of 20% and the other at a profit of 16%. If the selling price of both articles is same, then the cost price (in Rs.) of the article sold at 20% loss is:

questions.question: If x 2 + 4y 2 = 53 and x - 2y = 5, then what is the value of x 3 - 8y 3 ?

Shortcut Trick 
 Put x = 7, y = 1

x3 - 8y3 = 73 - 8(1)3

 Alternate Method

Given:

x2 + 4y2 = 53 and x - 2y = 5

Formula:

(a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab

a3 - b3 = (a - b)(a2 + ab + b2)

Calculation:

⇒ (x - 2y)2 = x2 - 4xy + 4y2

⇒ 25 = 53 - 4xy

⇒ xy = 7

Then,

⇒ x3 - 8y3 = (x)3 - (2y)3

⇒ x3 - (2y)3 = (x - 2y)(x2 + 2xy + 4y2)

= 5 × (53 + 2 × 7)

∴ x3 - 8y3 = 335

 x + y = 2 and \(\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y}=\frac{18}{5}\)

a3 + b3 = (a + b)(a2 - ab + b2)

questions.solution:
Calculation:

There will be a total of 41 members in the factory = 39 workers + 2 managers

Daily wages of the managers ranges between 700 and 800, it would be calculated on the basis of 750.

Similarly, the calculation would be done according to the midpoints (for eg. if 5  employees have their salaries between 200 to 300, it will be solved as 5 × 250)

Total daily wages of all members of staff of the factory = 250 × 5 + 350 × 9 + 450 × 12 + 550 × 11 + 650 × 2 + 750 × 2 = Rs.18650

Total number of workers = 5 + 9 + 12 + 11 + 2 + 2 = 41

questions.question: A boat goes 27 km upstream and 33 km downstream in 6 hours. In the same time it can go 36 km upstream and 22 km downstream. How much time will it take to go 36 km upstream and 44 km downstream?
questions.questionHtml: A boat goes 27 km upstream and 33 km downstream in 6 hours. In the same time it can go 36 km upstream and 22 km downstream. How much time will it take to go 36 km upstream and 44 km downstream?
questions.solution:
Given:

27km upstream and 33km downstream = 6 hours

36km upstream and 22km downstream = 6 hours

Formula:

Speed of boat = a kmph and Speed of stream = b kmph

Speed of upstream = (a - b) kmph

Speed of downstream = (a + b) kmph

Calculation:

⇒ 33/(a + b) + 27/(a - b) = 6

⇒ 22/(a + b) + 36/(a - b) = 6

Then,

⇒ 33/(a + b) + 27/(a - b) = 22/(a + b) + 36/(a - b)

⇒ 11/(a + b) = 9/(a - b) 

⇒ 11a - 11b = 9a + 9b

⇒ 2a = 20b

⇒ a = 10b

Then,

⇒ 33/(10b + b) + 27/(10b - b) = 6

⇒ 3/b + 3/b = 6

⇒ b = 1

⇒ a = 10

Speed downstream = 10 + 1 = 11 kmph

Speed upstream = 10 - 1 = 9 kmph

Then,

⇒ ? = 44/11 + 36/9 

⇒ ? = 4 + 4

⇒ ? = 8

∴ it will take 8 hours to go 36 km upstream and 44 km downstream.

questions.question: Fourth proportion to 12, 18 and 6 is same as the third proportion to k and 6. What is the value of k?
questions.questionHtml: Fourth proportion to 12, 18 and 6 is same as the third proportion to k and 6. What is the value of k?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Fourth proportion (x) = (18 × 6) ÷ 12 = 9

Third proportion (9) = 62 ÷ k

⇒ k = 36 ÷ 9 = 4

∴ The correct answer is 4.

Alternate Method

Given: Numbers 12, 18, 6 for fourth proportion; k, 6 for third proportion.

Formula Used: Fourth proportion (x) of a, b, c is (b × c)/a. Third proportion (c) of a, b is b2/a.

⇒ Let the fourth proportion be x.

⇒ 12/18 = 6/x

⇒ x = (18 × 6) ÷ 12 = 9

⇒ Now, 9 is the third proportion to k and 6.

⇒ k : 6 = 6 : 9

⇒ 9 = 62 ÷ k

⇒ 9k = 36

⇒ k = 4

∴ The correct answer is 4.

Additional Information

Mean Proportion

The mean proportion between two numbers a and b is √(a × b).

Continued Proportion

Three numbers a, b, c are in continued proportion if a/b = b/c, which implies b2 = ac.

Invertendo and Alternendo

If a/b = c/d, then b/a = d/c (Invertendo) and a/c = b/d (Alternendo).

questions.question: In ΔABC, DE || AB, where D and E are the points on sides AC and BC, respectively. If AD = x - 3, AC = 2x, BE = x - 2 and BC = 2x + 3, then what is the value of x?

Given:

Concept used:

If a line parallel to one side of a triangle intersects the other two sides of the triangle, then the line divides these two sides proportionally.

Calculation:

AC = AD + DC

⇒ CD = 2x - x + 3 = (x + 3)

then,

CD/AD = CE/BE

⇒ (x + 3)/(x - 3) = (x + 5)/(x - 2)

⇒ x2 + x - 6 = x2 + 2x - 15

 ⇒ x = 9

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution required’. I asked Rahul that how far was his office from his home.

Here the correct answer is How far his office was.
Key Points
  • In the above-given sentence, 'how far his office was' should be used instead of 'that how far was his office'.
  • It is so because the given sentence is an example of indirect speech.
  • The conjunction 'that' is not used in indirect speech for question sentences. 
  • Thus, 'that' should be removed.
  • When we convert a question sentence into indirect speech, the positions of subject and verb are interchanged i.e. in the indirect speech the subject 'his office' comes before the auxiliary verb 'was'.
  • For Example:-
    • Direct Speech - He asked me, "Have you finished reading the book?"
    • Indirect Speech - He asked me whether I had finished reading the book.
  • Thus, the correct answer is Option 3.


Correct Sentence - I asked Rahul how far his office was from his home.
Hinglish 

  • ऊपर दिए गए वाक्य में, 'that how far was his office' के बजाय इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए 'how far his office was'।

  • प्रश्न वाक्यों के लिए अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण में संयोजन 'that' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है।
  • अत: 'that' को हटा देना चाहिए।
  • जब हम एक प्रश्न वाक्य को अप्रत्यक्ष वाक्य में बदलते हैं, तो विषय और क्रिया की स्थान बदल जाता है यानी अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण में विषय 'his office' सहायक क्रिया 'was' से पहले आता है।
  • उदाहरण के लिए:-
    • Direct Speech - He asked me, "Have you finished reading the book?"

  • अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. Help the needy people.

Here the correct answer is Let the needy people be helped.
Key Points
  • The given sentence is in an active voice form, hence we need to convert it into a passive voice form.
  • We need to follow these instructions while changing the voice of an imperative sentence.
  • An imperative sentence does not normally have a subject.
  • It is used to express a command or request.
  • The imperative sentence in the passive voice takes the following form:
    • Let + object + be + past participle.
  • Example: 
    • ​Do this task. (Active Voice)
    • Let this task be done. (Passive Voice)
  • Thus, the object of the active voice 'the needy people' will come after 'let' which will further be followed by 'be' and past participle form of help i.e. helped.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.


Correct Passive Voice - Let the needy people be helped.

Hinglish 

  • दिया गया वाक्य active voice form में है, इसलिए हमें इसे passive voice form में बदलने की आवश्यकता है।
  • एक imperative sentence की voice बदलते समय हमें इन निर्देशों का पालन करने की आवश्यकता है।
  • एक imperative sentence में आमतौर पर कोई विषय नहीं होता है।
  • इसका उपयोग किसी आदेश या अनुरोध को व्यक्त करने के लिए किया जाता है।
  • Passive Voice में imperative sentence निम्नलिखित रूप लेता है:
    • Let + object + be + past participle
  • उदाहरण:
    • ​Do this task. (Active Voice)
    • Let this task be done. (Passive Voice)
  • इसलिए, सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. I was shocked to find my house unlocked.

B. To my astonishment, I found that my son, who had a spare key, had come in my absence.

C. Last Sunday I returned home late at night.

D. I ran inside in fear that my house has been robbed.
questions.solution:
The correct arrangement is CADB.

Key Points

  • The sentence starts with the topic "Last Sunday I returned home late at night." It gives us s starting of a subject. That means the first statement is C.
  • The next sentence will be followed by sentence A "I was shocked to find my house unlocked." Sentence A shows that the speaker is reacting to his house being unlocked at late night. This is the most appropriate sentence that follows sentence C.
  • The next sentence should be his reaction when he found out that his house was unlocked. The correct sentence that will follow sentence A is sentence D. "I ran inside in fear that my house has been robbed."
  • Ann the last sentence will be sentence B, "To my astonishment, I found that my son, who had a spare key, had come in my absence." This sentence also gives the speaker a sense of relief and thus ends the fear of the speaker.
  • Arrangement: "Last Sunday I returned home late at night. I was shocked to find my house unlocked. I ran inside in fear that my house has been robbed. To my astonishment, I found that my son, who had a spare key, had come in my absence."
  • Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
